messages:
Priya Desai: FYI found a potential exposure from a vendor search-indexer service — looks like it leaked some embedding IDs into logs. Not confirmed user data leaked, but we need containment.
Devon Kim: any POC? where did it surface?
Priya Desai: spike in SLO logs -> /var/log/thirdparty/indexer.log showed UUIDs matching our embedding IDs. Searched cluster: indexer service had READ access to vector snapshots due to a mis-scoped role.
Maria Lopez: ack. Recommend immediate RBAC deny-list for that service account, and rotate KMS key if it had access.
Samuel (infra): I'm on it — will apply temporary deny policy and revoke the service account keys. ETA 10m.
Priya Desai: Also need to enable verbose audit logging for keystore + access path /keystore/embeddings and create retention hold for snapshots 2024-03-01..2024-03-10 for DSAR/forensics.
Devon Kim: retention hold makes sense. How will DSAR team access the evidence? we should checkpoint before rotating keys.
Maria Lopez: We'll export a signed manifest of current snapshots to GCS with restricted ACLs, hash proof with `sha256sum`, then rotate KMS.
Samuel (infra): command I'm applying (pseudo):
```
# revoke access and add deny binding
gcloud projects set-iam-policy myproj policy.json
# policy.json contains a deny binding for serviceAccount:vendor-indexer@vendor.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
Samuel (infra): audit-bot: please enable keystore audit-level=verbose for resource keystore-prod
audit-bot: Keystore audit-level changed to verbose by Samuel (infra) at 3041592030. Logs will be retained 90d.
Priya Desai: Add retention exception ticket for 30 days and tag legal + privacy. We need a DSAR fast path if subject asks about indexer-induced exposure.
Maria Lopez: Assigned to me for manifest + hash proof. I will upload to gs://redwood-forensics/holds/3041592000-manifest.txt and post ACL to #eng-security when done.
Devon Kim: Also file a vuln triage entry and link to the vendor support case. I'll open a JIRA: INF-4921.
Samuel (infra): RBAC deny applied and service account disabled at 3041592045. KMS rotate scheduled at 3041592100 after manifest upload.
Priya Desai: Thanks team. Follow-ups: Maria create manifest, Legal@privacy on alert, Devon JIRA + vendor, Samuel monitor for any replays. Update this thread with artifacts.
Maria Lopez: Manifest uploaded, link: gs://redwood-forensics/holds/3041592000-manifest.txt (ACL restricted). Hash: `sha256:4b227777d4dd1fc61c6f884f48641d02` (truncated).
audit-bot: Ticket INF-4921 created by Devon Kim at 3041592070.
Devon Kim: I'll ping vendor account manager now :phone:.
Priya Desai: Closing loop — we still need a retention exception approval from compliance for the 30-day hold. @Legal please advise.
Legal: acknowledged, will start approval process and confirm record-level rationale.
Samuel (infra): KMS rotation completed at 3041592120, old key disabled.
Priya Desai: Great, keep this thread updated if anything else pops. :lock:
